channel.title: LA Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from LA Daily News (dailynews.com)

item.title: LA County investigates LAHSA financial practices, including inability to pay providers to homeless
item.description: With more delays paying on-street groups performing homeless services, Supervisor Horvath said the county has to pull all its tax dollars from LAHSA.

item.title: Cabrillo camp set for Olympics training will need repairs, Port of LA says
item.description: A beachfront youth camp in the Port of Los Angeles will need repairs, officials said Thursday.

item.title: Deposed Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro asks judge to toss out indictment against him
item.description: Maduro's attorney says the U.S. government violated his client’s due process rights by blocking funds.

item.title: Pasadena, LA, Baldwin Park plaintiffs allege local immigration raids target Latinos
item.description: The local plaintiffs have amended their closely watched lawsuit against the Department of Homeland Security, adding two new claims: 1) The government is intentionally discriminating against Latino communities in California, and 2) agents use highly intrusive tactics in carrying out their raids

item.title: Lakers don’t dwell on late collapse against Magic ahead of 2-game trip
item.description: Speaking before Thursday’s game, Coach JJ Redick says the ebbs and flows of an 82-game regular season mean there’s no need to “belabor” every defeat, no matter how frustrating it is.

item.title: What to know about LAUSD’s AllHere contract following federal searches
item.description: A look at the timeline, fraud charges and what authorities have confirmed, and not confirmed.

item.title: In Palisades, a Caruso-led tour with San Jose’s mayor becomes forum for fire recovery challenges
item.description: San Jose Mayor Matt Mahan, a candidate for governor, has positioned himself as a critic of Gov. Gavin Newsom. On Thursday, he heard concerns emerging from the area as it rebuilds. Chief among them: Insurance

item.title: Lakers can’t slow depleted Suns, lose on last-second 3-pointer
item.description: Luka Doncic has 41 points and the Lakers erase a 12-point deficit late, but Royce O’Neale makes a 3-pointer with 0.9 seconds remaining – the Suns’ 22nd 3 of the night – to hand them a 113-110 defeat.

item.title: Short-handed Clippers can’t outlast Anthony Edwards, Timberwolves
item.description: The Clippers, playing without Kawhi Leonard and John Collins, take a lead into the fourth quarter, but Edwards (31 points) buries a step-back 3-pointer with 42.9 seconds left to help Minnesota hold them off, 94-88.

item.title: Struggling Kings routed by Oilers for 5th straight loss
item.description: One night after surrendering five goals in the third period of a loss to Vegas, they are humiliated by their postseason nemesis, 8-1, as the fan ire directed at Coach Jim Hiller reaches a new volume.
